paragraphs: I'm a robotics and AI engineer at SWB, where I own the ROS 2 platform behind Manara — an in-production service robot helping pilgrims at the Two Holy Mosques — and the software that runs our fleet of four robots.

My background is AI: I graduated with honors in Informatics Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) from the University of Aleppo in 2025, then taught myself robotics on the job. The problems I like most sit between the two — making autonomy work on real hardware, with weak actuators, limited sensors and networks that drop out.
I also design ROS 2 course material — the BurgerBot driving around the top of this page comes from it — and build open tools like ps4_teleop.
